clips.title: The story
paras: Across Red Cloud Mesa, Plainstrider Meat helps feed Camp Narache. Young tauren hunt the birds for food and feathers, proving their skill and self-reliance.

Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa depends on game from the surrounding grasslands. Plainstrider meat helps feed the village when food stocks run low. The birds also provide feathers for clothing and ceremonial adornments. Tauren life depends on the land, and survival means taking what is needed while respecting nature.

Grull Hawkwind sends young hunters across Red Cloud Mesa to track the swift plainstriders. They gather meat and feathers to prove their tracking skill and self-reliance. Then they appear before Grull's father, Chief Hawkwind.
